purpose: Explicit cut-off contract for every snapshot in this directory, because none of the official pages prints one (see the corrected FLG-02). Anything read from these files inherits these timestamps.

standings.includes: every regular-season game completed on or before 2026-11-12, i.e. all of Week 9 plus the Week 10 Thursday game (WAS 24, NYG 21)
standings.excludes: Week 10 Saturday/Sunday/Monday games (unplayed at fetch time)
standings.evidence: reconciled against data/desk/games.json: weeks 1-9 sums plus the Week-10 Thursday final reproduce every club's W, L, T, PF and PA exactly (VER-19)

injuries.includes: the Week 10 practice and game-status designations as published on Saturday 2026-11-14 18:08 UTC
injuries.excludes: Sunday inactive lists (published about 90 minutes before kickoff) and any Monday re-designation
injuries.note: the page mutates between fetches: one practice status changed in 24 hours (FLG-03), so this file is a snapshot, not a record of the week

slate.includes: the Week 10 schedule as published 2026-11-14, including the Thursday result and the four byes
slate.note: Weeks 16-18 kickoffs remain subject to flex scheduling per the same page, so later weeks are not frozen

depth_overlay.includes: club-published depth charts captured 2026-11-14 by the desk pipeline and joined to the Week 10 injury report
depth_overlay.note: 76 of 76 rows carry no as-of date from the publishing club and 50 come from charts the club labels unofficial: this file is an UNVERIFIED overlay and no model input uses it

game_log.includes: 163 scheduled rows for 2026 weeks 1-11, of which 137 are final
game_log.note: one season only; no prices and no prior seasons, so it cannot calibrate the model parameters (Q-03, Q-07)

rule: a derived statistic must name the snapshot it came from; if a page cannot state its cut-off, the value is not published as current
